sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Private Investment Holding for High-Net-Worth Family Assets

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (unitary jurisdiction; SAS governed by national law, no sub-state corporate law differentiation applicable)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic codified system; French Civil Code and Commercial Code as primary corporate law sources)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Bilateral Investment Treaty of 1984 (mutual promotional protection of investments; in force)
France–China Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (1984, amended by 2013 Protocol; covering dividends, interest, royalties, capital gains and tie-breaker rules)
France–Hong Kong SAR Double Taxation Agreement (2010, in force; relevant to structured family-office holding flows)
France–Singapore Double Taxation Agreement (1962, as amended; favorable passive-income treatment for corporate investors)
France–Switzerland Double Taxation Agreement (1966, as amended; UBO tax residence and substance tie-breakers)
France–United Kingdom Double Taxation Agreement (2008, as amended; investment vehicle income characterization)
France–United States Tax Treaty (1994 Convention, amended by 2006 and 2009 Protocols) together with FATCA IGA (Model 1A)
EU–China Comprehensive Agreement on Investment (negotiations concluded 2020; not yet in force at knowledge cutoff)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier Articles L.561-1 to L.561-51 (AML/CFT obligations, customer due diligence and TRACFIN reporting) transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5); Code de commerce Articles L.123-1 et seq. and L.123-33 (Registre National des Entreprises - RNE); Décret n° 2021-711 du 3 juin 2021 (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs - RBE, UBO filing thresholds and deadlines); Décret n° 2020-118 du 12 février 2020; Loi n° 2020-1672 du 24 décembre 2020 (Loi ASAP) on RBE accessibility; Conseil d'État Decision n° 461842 (16 July 2023) suspending general public access to RBE data for non-listed entities with fewer than 250 employees; Code général des impôts Articles 1729-0 A and 1731 (penalties for deficient or late declarations); Arrêtés du Ministre de l'Économie (gels d'avoirs) implementing EU and UN Security Council financial sanctions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of valid passport or national ID of each Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO), statutory Président/Directeur and any authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the country of origin OR French consular authority (for acts executed in France, a notaire français)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for documents issued in Apostille-contracting states) OR Consular Legalization (for documents from non-Hague jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Extract from the foreign companies register of each corporate shareholder (Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum/Articles, Certificate of Good Standing, register of directors and shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille of the registry extract OR dual consular legalization chain (foreign Ministry of Foreign Affairs + French Embassy/Consulate) where the origin state is not an Apostille party

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and source-of-wealth letter issued by the sponsor private banking institution and addressed to French incorporation counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sponsor private bank or financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature certification + sworn French translation (traducteur assermenté); apostille required only where the issuing bank demands legalized official letterhead

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (mandat) authorizing the French intermediary to file incorporation formalities, publish the JAL notice and execute RNE filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary in the jurisdiction of each UBO or statutory appointee
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization together with sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or recent bank statement) for each UBO and statutory officer; proof of availability of the French registered office (siège social)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original or certified copy with sworn French translation; apostille required only for foreign-origin documents

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence (EDD) at Stage 1 for every UBO, statutory officer and discretionary-appointed family-office manager covering: (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List under Council Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 and related CFSP sanctions; (iii) UN Security Council consolidated lists (UNSCR 1267/1989/2253 ISIL–Al-Qaida, 1988 Taliban, 1718 DPRK, 2231 Iran); (iv) French national asset-freezing measure list (gels d'avoirs) administered by the Direction générale du Trésor; (v) domestic PEP, senior foreign official, SOE and international-organization PEP indicators per Directive (EU) 2015/849 Article 3(9); and (vi) adverse media and FATF-recognized AML deficiency list screening. Any sanctions hit, PEP flag without rationally justified lawful source of wealth, or inconsistency between UBO declarations and banking evidence must be escalated to TRACFIN (French FIU) and the engagement declined where suspicion remains unresolved. CDD/KYC records must be retained for a minimum of five years after termination of the business relationship under Article L.561-31 of the Code monétaire et financier.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle, with mandatory verifications against the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and the INPI trademark database (Data INPI / Infogreffe legacy data)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All incorporation forms and statutory instruments must be completed in the French language (Loi n° 94-665 du 4 août 1994; Code de commerce Article L.123-1). The corporate denomination may be a foreign-language expression only where transcribed in Latin script; any transliteration must be declared and a sworn French translation provided for RNE filing. The name must include the legal form indicator 'SAS' or the words 'Société par Actions Simplifiée', must not be identical or confusingly similar to existing RNE records or trademarks, and must not mislead third parties as to the regulated nature or legal form of the entity.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Banque', 'Crédit', 'Financier', 'Fiduciaire', 'Fonds', 'Placement', 'Gestion d'actifs', 'Portefeuille' – reserved for ACPR-authorized credit institutions, investment firms or asset-management companies (Code monétaire et financier; ACPR Instruction 2020-11)
'Assurance', 'Mutuelle', 'Courtier d'assurance', 'Intermédiaire' – reserved for ACPR/ORIAS-registered insurance and intermediation undertakings
'Notaire', 'Avocat', 'Expert-Comptable', 'Commissaire aux Comptes' – reserved to regulated legal or accountancy professionals
'Bourse', 'Marché financier', 'Chambre de compensation', 'Clearing' – misleading capital-market registry terms
'État', 'République', 'Présidence', 'Ministère', 'National', 'France' in a governmental-connection context requiring prior ministerial approval
Legal-form abbreviations 'SA', 'SARL', 'SCI', 'SCA', 'SASU' used inconsistently with the adopted 'SAS' structure
Tokens of unauthorized collective investment ('OPC', 'FCP', 'SICAV', 'Club de placement') triggering AMF re-qualification risk for a family-office vehicle
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Guichet Unique rejects the proposed denomination: (i) the representative refiles a corrected statement through the same portal, invoking the 'droit à l'erreur' (right to correction) under Code des relations entre le public et l'administration Article L.211-5; (ii) where rejection arises from an earlier registered company or prior trademark, the applicant may file an opposition or cancellation action before the INPI or the competent Tribunal judiciaire within the statutory two-month opposition window; (iii) an administrative request for reconsideration (recours gracieux) may be submitted to the INPI Director or the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce that processed the file, annexing the original RNE extract and the corrected denomination; (iv) if refused, a full administrative appeal (recours de pleine juridiction) must be lodged with the competent Tribunal administratif within two months of notification of the refusal; (v) alternatively the denomination may be protected as a secondary trading name pending a new filing, while the entity proceeds with a pre-filed trademark application to lock the name during the 30-day reservation window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permissible: the SAS may establish its siège social at the premises of a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) under Code de commerce Article L.123-11-2 and Décret n° 2020-1340. However, a purely virtual mailbox with no local employment, governance meetings or asset custody function will (a) fail the 'direction effective et contrôle' test for French tax residence under CGI Article 4 A, (b) undermine treaty-benefit assertions under any double taxation agreement, and (c) generate constructive substance flags under BEPS Action 6 and POEM jurisprudence. For an ISIC 6430 single-family office, minimum expected substance is a private office address, at least one meeting facility, and documented board or investment-committee minutes taken at the French address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 10%–15% annual probability of unannounced URSSAF, DGFiP, greffe or inspection visits for a passive private-holding family office. Probability rises above 30% where a UBO is a PEP, where securities custody or high-value wires exceed EUR 150,000, or where TRACFIN receives a suspicious transaction report from the custody bank. The AML risk tier for this mandate is 'Medium-Enhanced', requiring the file to evidence premises control and substance at first inspection.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI/Guichet Unique filing fee for the RNE creation file, including the RBE (bénéficiaires effectifs) declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI – Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by Arrêté of 17 March 2022 (EUR 36–40 plus dependent schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce registration fee and issuance of the Kbis extract (including dispatch to competent administration)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce compétent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory greffe tariff scale; approximately EUR 47–57 for SAS création

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10, L.227-1 to L.227-30; Decree No. 67-236 of 23 March 1967, Articles R.123-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) – operated by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via the Guichet Unique de l'INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 – Demande d'immatriculation au registre du commerce et des sociétés (accompanied by the executed statuts and annexes)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; freely determined in the articles. Share capital must be fully subscribed; cash contributions must be paid up to at least 50% at incorporation, the balance within 5 years; in-kind contributions fully paid up upon transfer.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The undersigned sole shareholder of the SAS to be formed under French law, at today's date, resolves as follows: (i) The share capital of EUR 10,000, comprised of 10,000 ordinary shares of EUR 1 each, is fully subscribed and the required minimum part of cash contributions is paid up in accordance with Article L.227-2 of the French Commercial Code; (ii) The registered office is established at 24 Avenue Montaigne, 75008 Paris, France; (iii) Mrs. Isabelle Delacroix is hereby appointed as President of the company, with all powers granted by law and the articles of association; (iv) The President is authorised to carry out all formalities for the RCS registration, to open bank accounts and to take any measures necessary for the formation and commencement of operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of the Articles of Association and Initial Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary (if notarised) or shareholders acting under private seal (sous seing privé)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the French-language statuts setting out legal form (SAS), corporate name, registered office, share capital, corporate purpose (private holding and management of family assets) and duration. Appoint the first President in the statuts or by a separate act. If contributions in kind are made, obtain a rapport du commissaire aux apports where required by law. Notarisation is mandatory if real estate contributes to the capital.
required_dossiers: Identity documents (passport) of shareholders
Draft statuts in French
Proof of address for the registered office
Report of the commissaire aux apports (if applicable)
Appointment deed for the President
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the greffe or notary flags incomplete clauses, amend and re-sign the statuts or the act; no limitation period applies on resubmission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of a Legal Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A legal announcements newspaper (Journal d'Annonces Légales) approved in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a formal notice containing the SAS name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate object, duration and the name and identity of the President. Place the order online or in person with the newspaper; obtain the attestation de parution upon publication.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts or a summary of the incorporation
Notice text to be published
Order form and payment for publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is defective, publish a correcting announcement in the same newspaper and retain both attestations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (for cash contributions); notary for notarised in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the SAS in formation with a French bank and deposit the cash contribution amounts. The bank issues a certificate of deposit (certificat de dépôt des fonds) confirming the credit balance. If the statuts are notarised, the notary may hold the funds.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts
Proof of identity of legal representative
Bank account opening forms
Source of funds declaration (AML requirement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses or delays the deposit, select another accredited bank or request the deposit with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the certificate must be re-issued before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Incorporation Dossier with the RCS via the Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique de l'INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the online application on the Guichet Unique, uploading the executed statuts, the legal notice attestation, the bank capital deposit certificate, the declaration of conformity (déclaration de conformité) signed by the President, and the statutory supporting documents. Pay the greffe fees online. The system dispatches the dossier to the competent RCS clerk.
required_dossiers: Formulaire M0 (automatically generated by the portal)
Executed statuts (signed by all shareholders)
Attestation de parution from the legal announcement journal
Certificate of capital deposit issued by the bank
Déclaration de conformité
Identity documents of shareholders and the President
Declaration of non-conviction for the President (bulletin n°3, if applicable)
Power of attorney if a representative files
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is queried, the greffe issues a notice to correct or complete; rectify the missing items electronically within 15 days. If rejected, amend the dossier and resubmit with an updated payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Kbis Extract and Administrative Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) and INSEE (automatic SIREN/SIRET assignment)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the RCS registers the company and issues the official Kbis extract, with the SIREN/SIRET numbers automatically transmitted by INSEE. Verify the Kbis data for accuracy. The Kbis serves as proof of legal existence and corporate capacity for banking and contractual purposes.
required_dossiers: RCS registration number (provided via the portal confirmation)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis contains errors, submit a corrective request to the greffe; if the Kbis is delayed beyond 5 days, contact the greffe in writing or via the portal and request expedition.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the business is a private investment holding (ISIC 6430) with no industrial or manufacturing activity; the Direction Générale des Entreprises is not a required authority.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No operating license required. A simple 'déclaration de début d'activité' is integrated in the registration formalities and suffices for the holding activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not applicable – office-based financial activity; no environmental authorization required under the ICPE (Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement) framework.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no polluting activity; no EIA report or registration.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable. Should the office waste management or energy use trigger local bylaws, the company must comply with the municipal waste collection rules and the general administrative provisions of the Code de l'environnement; no VOCs or wastewater discharge are generated.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The premises must comply with fire safety regulations for ERPs (établissements recevant du public) if open to clients, or the workplace safety rules of the Code du travail. Required: a 'document unique d'évaluation des risques' (DUER), electrical installations inspection at least every 5 years, and a fire extinguisher supervision contract. For offices at more than 200 employees, a CHSCT/CSE workplace health and safety assessment may be triggered.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP), principally through the Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) or, for qualifying non-established foreign businesses, the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères (SIEE); online tax administration portal: impots.gouv.fr. Customs registrations and export formalities are administered by the Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects (DGDDI) through douane.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SAS is incorporated and reported through the guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle (INPI). Following registration, the competent registry and INSEE issue the SIREN and establishment-specific SIRET identifiers. The company requests or confirms its French VAT identification number with the competent SIE, generally in the format FR plus the two-digit key and nine-digit SIREN. A non-established foreign entity carrying out taxable transactions in France applies to the SIEE or other designated DGFiP service using the prescribed registration and VAT documentation, including constitutional documents, foreign tax certificate, business activity description, French customer or transaction information, identification of the legal representative, and banking details where requested. A business conducting customs operations must separately obtain an EORI number from DGDDI. Registration does not arise merely from passive ownership of investments where the activity is outside the scope of VAT, but VAT registration may be required for taxable services, intra-Community acquisitions, imports, or other taxable transactions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SAS is ordinarily subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés). Subject to statutory eligibility conditions, including limits concerning ownership, employee headcount, turnover or balance-sheet size, and the nature of the activity, an unlisted SAS may elect temporarily for income tax treatment under the regime applicable to certain partnerships and qualifying companies. The election is generally limited to five financial years and must be made within the statutory deadline. There is no general United States-style check-the-box election for a French SAS. French anti-hybrid mismatch rules may deny deductions or impose inclusion where arrangements produce deduction or non-inclusion or duplicate deduction outcomes; they do not constitute a general entity-classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT), administered under the French and European Union VAT framework
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For the French franchise en base regime, the principal turnover thresholds are generally EUR 85,000 for supplies of goods, sales for consumption on the premises, and accommodation, and EUR 37,500 for services, with higher tolerance thresholds generally of EUR 93,500 and EUR 41,250 respectively, subject to applicable year, sector, transaction, and legislative rules. A pure investment holding company that only holds securities or receives dividends generally has no taxable economic activity for VAT purposes. Taxable management, advisory, administrative, or other services supplied by the family office are assessed under the applicable VAT rules; registration may also be required for intra-Community acquisitions, imports, reverse-charge transactions, or transactions exceeding the applicable franchise thresholds. The French VAT threshold rules have been subject to recent legislative changes and transitional measures and must be verified for the relevant filing year.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing mandatory electronic invoicing and electronic transaction reporting through approved private platforms connected to the public directory and the public invoicing portal. The framework is not a universal real-time pre-clearance model. All French businesses must be able to receive electronic invoices from 1 September 2026. Issuance obligations generally begin on 1 September 2026 for large enterprises and medium-sized enterprises and on 1 September 2027 for small and micro-enterprises, subject to statutory transitional rules. B2B domestic invoices are transmitted in prescribed structured formats, including permitted hybrid formats such as Factur-X, through an approved platform. B2C and certain cross-border transactions may require electronic reporting rather than invoice clearance. Required invoice data, payment information, transaction classification, and VAT details must be transmitted in the prescribed digital format; VAT invoices remain subject to French retention and audit-access requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from France to destinations outside the European Union may be exempt from French VAT with the right to deduct input VAT when the supplier can establish that the goods left the European Union and satisfy the documentary and transactional requirements. Evidence generally includes the customs export declaration, electronic exit confirmation, commercial invoice, transport documentation, and a clear link between the supplier, goods, consignee, and export movement. Intra-Community supplies of goods may qualify for exemption where the customer has a valid VAT number in another EU Member State, the goods are dispatched to that Member State, and the supplier retains required transport and reporting evidence. B2B services supplied to a business established outside France are generally governed by place-of-supply rules and may be outside the scope of French VAT or subject to reverse charge, rather than technically being zero-rated exports. Passive investment income, including dividends, is generally outside the scope of VAT; taxable family-office services require separate analysis.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic customs export declaration and its Movement Reference Number (MRN)
Electronic confirmation that the goods exited the European Union, or equivalent customs exit evidence
Commercial invoice identifying the French supplier, customer, goods, value, and export destination
Bill of lading, airway bill, CMR consignment note, or other appropriate transport document
Packing list and purchase or sales documentation sufficient to link the goods to the export declaration
Import or delivery evidence in the destination country where required or commercially available

Proof of payment or contractual evidence where necessary to substantiate the transaction, although France does not generally require an inward remittance certificate as a statutory export-VAT document
For intra-Community supplies, the customer’s valid EU VAT number, transport evidence, and required EC Sales List reporting
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France does not impose a general 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation deadline for export proceeds. Export VAT exemption or refund claims may be reassessed where exit, transport, customer, invoice, or transaction evidence is incomplete, inconsistent, fabricated, or unavailable. The tax authority may recover improperly exempted or refunded VAT, assess statutory late-payment interest, and impose penalties under the French Tax Code, including penalties commonly equal to 40% for deliberate non-compliance and up to 80% for fraudulent maneuvers or abusive conduct, subject to the facts and applicable procedural rules. Customs sanctions, repayment of improperly obtained customs benefits, and seizure measures may also apply. Serious intentional tax fraud may trigger criminal proceedings, including fines and imprisonment under applicable French criminal tax-fraud provisions. Records should generally be retained for the statutory tax limitation period, commonly three years plus the current year for VAT assessments, with longer periods applying in specified circumstances.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains unrestricted capital account convertibility with no regulatory restrictions on capital movements or profit remittances for resident entities. Current account transactions are freely convertible at market rates. Profit remittances to shareholders are permitted without convertibility hurdles, subject only to standard corporate governance and tax withholding requirements.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds. All exports require customs declaration under the Single Window system. Voluntary statistical reporting to the Banque de France is available for transparency but not obligatory. FX transactions occur at prevailing market rates with no statutory conversion ratios.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for licensed fintech EMI providers such as Revolut Business or N26 Business for cross-border payments, subject to mandatory French AML/KYC compliance, beneficial ownership registration in the French corporate registry, and potential correspondent banking restrictions for non-EU offshore activities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding and e-KYC are generally permitted for French SAS entities. Physical presence and in-person KYC interviews are required only for high-risk transactions, complex beneficial ownership structures, or upon specific bank request for enhanced due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership disclosure failure or shell company indicators
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract from French corporate registry, beneficial ownership declaration form, and source of wealth documentation

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening hits or adverse media reports
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive client due diligence report, PEP declaration, and independent legal opinion confirming compliance

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound capital from foreign investors routed via SEPA credit transfers for EUR (purpose code 'CAP' or 'Capital contribution') or SWIFT MT103 for non-EUR currencies with detailed remittance advice referencing shareholder agreements and beneficial ownership certificates. Verification through bank statements, audited financial statements, and corporate registry extracts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements cleared primarily via SWIFT MT103 for international wire transfers or issuance of commercial letters of credit through correspondent banks. All settlements require supporting trade documentation, invoices, and full AML screening.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual deposit of approved SAS financial statements, management report (if applicable), audit report (if required), and shareholders' approval resolution in the RCS (dépôt des comptes annuels).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through the INPI Guichet des Formalités des Entreprises.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the SAS fiscal year-end; for a 31 December balance sheet date, on or before 30 June of the following calendar year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing exposes the SAS and its legal representatives to court-ordered injunction proceedings, daily astreinte, civil fines, and, after formal notice and persistent default, administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS, which entails loss of the company's legal existence.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and final settlement of corporate income tax and social contribution on profits (liasse fiscale n°2065-SD and related schedules, including the balance sheet, income statement, and tax annexes).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — Service des Impôts des Entreprises.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year SAS, the return is due online no later than the second working day after 1 May following the fiscal year close; non-calendar year-ends are due within two months of the balance sheet date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or late payment triggers statutory late-payment interest of 0.20% per month, a 5% automatic surcharge, a 10% penalty after formal notice, and a 40% penalty where the taxpayer continues for-profit activity in the absence of the required declaration; continued defaults enable enforced recovery against the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual shareholders' decision approving the annual accounts and determining the allocation of results (dividends, retained earnings, or reserves), recorded in the minute book and filed as an attachment to the annual RCS filing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate statutory records held at the registered office; copy attached to the RCS deposit before the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months of the fiscal year-end and in all cases before the annual accounts are deposited with the RCS.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to adopt the annual approval resolution invalidates the accounts deposit, triggers the six-month accounts filing sanction mechanism, and exposes the SAS president and directors to civil liability for shareholders' losses and to objections in proceedings before the commercial court.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner register confirmation and declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) attached to the annual company file and updated upon any shareholding transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS through the INPI Beneficial Ownership Register.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed with each annual accounts deposit; any change in beneficial ownership, share transfer, or control structure must be declared within 30 days of the relevant event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or knowingly false UBO information constitutes a criminal offense for SAS officers, with penalties of up to EUR 12,000 and imprisonment up to six months for natural persons; the registrar may also block the annual accounts filing and initiate RCS strike-off after formal notice.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory for the SAS where, on a stand-alone basis, it exceeds at least two of the three thresholds at the end of the preceding or current financial year: balance sheet total above EUR 4,000,000, net revenue above EUR 8,000,000, or 50 or more employees. Mandatory audit is also triggered if the SAS controls one or more entities and the consolidated group exceeds the same thresholds, or where the SAS articles expressly require an auditor.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory annual accounts are prepared under French GAAP, principally in accordance with the Code de commerce and the Plan Comptable Général (Règlement ANC n° 2014-03, as amended); IFRS is not mandatory for a standalone SAS and is materially relevant only in consolidated financial statements of listed groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must maintain an accurate beneficial ownership declaration in the RCS. The declaration is filed at incorporation, must be updated within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or change in economic ownership, and is confirmed or re-filed with the annual accounts deposit as part of the annual statutory maintenance cycle. The RCS/INPI system treats the annual re-confirmation of the beneficial owners as a condition precedent to the regular acceptance of the annual company file.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registre des décisions sociales)
Register of share transfers (Registre de mouvements de titres)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250-700 per year for registered office domiciliation and corporate agent services in France, depending on the city and service scope.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500-7,000 per year for a certified annual audit of a small single-family-office SAS holding portfolio assets; preparatory accountancy and filing services may be additional if not performed by in-house staff.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% reduced rate on first €42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs; Crédit d'Impôt Recherche (R&D tax credit); innovation and patent box incentives

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 1200 - Déclaration de résultat via e-impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 15th day of the 4th month following fiscal year-end (e.g. 15 April for calendar year FY)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net turnover for the fiscal year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report based on separate or consolidated accounts; non-residents must provide beneficial ownership and treaty details

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit or loss before corporate tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Incorporate transfer pricing adjustments, interest deductibility limits, and other tax treatments

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 0.5% per month of tax due (capped at 25%); criminal prosecution for intentional non-filing

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC (Demande de réduction de retenue à la source) to French tax authorities with supporting documentation proving treaty eligibility and beneficial ownership
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 25% statutory rate, reduced under DTAs (typically 0-10%); Interest: 25% statutory, reduced to 0% under most DTAs

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 1,000,000 EUR (simplified local file) or 50,000,000 EUR (standard local file) for controlled transactions
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France enforces economic substance requirements for holding companies and IP regimes under BEPS and domestic GAAR; must demonstrate real economic activities, employees, and assets

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to declare income or understating profits in the corporate tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 500% of evaded tax, imprisonment up to 5 years; civil restitution orders
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for unpaid taxes; possible disqualification, fines, and imprisonment for willful misconduct

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the SAS without genuine economic activity or for artificial tax avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of the company; imposition of back taxes, penalties up to 500% of tax benefit sought
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil piercing; directors face personal liability, travel bans, and criminal sanctions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file suspicious transaction reports or maintain adequate AML/KYC procedures
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines exceeding €1 million; possible criminal prosecution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, disqualification from directorships, and imprisonment for serious breaches
